posts.title: Slopcore
posts.description: AI music videos are called slop. Some of them are good, and the slop complaint is a commons argument: Hardin and Ostrom have been arguing about it for decades.

posts.title: The Caveat Is Dead and We Have Killed It
posts.description: We are, I think, entering a post-caveat age. The machines now hedge for us, and the hostile audience we used to write against can help us go viral.
